highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.154.0 updates the bundled renderer to Skia m154 while retaining the recent GPU and readback improvements.
highlights_body: This cumulative release includes Graphite GPU bindings, asynchronous pixel readback, and managed lifetime corrections. Linux applications that rely on fontconfig fallback should review the changed font selection behavior.

breaking.title: Linux font fallback can select a different face
breaking.body: Skia now tries FcFontMatch before the previous FcFontSort fallback path, which can change text metrics or glyphs. Specify an explicit family and style, or use a bundled typeface, when deterministic font selection matters.

bullets.lead: Skia advanced through m152, m153, and m154
bullets.detail: Updates the bundled rendering engine with the m152 release and servicing fixes, the m153 stability updates, and the m154 engine update.
Adds Graphite bindings for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn so applications can target Skia's newer GPU rendering architecture.
SKImage and SKSurface now provide backend-neutral RequestReadPixels APIs for asynchronous pixel retrieval.
Provides a SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package for applications using Silk.NET's Vulkan bindings.
Prevents native use-after-free errors when iterating SKRegion spans or creating SKPixmap subsets and derived pixmaps.

bullets.lead: Raster and runtime-effect resources released correctly
bullets.detail: Fixes an allocation leak after failed raster image creation and releases the previous uniform buffer when SKRuntimeEffectUniforms is reset.
Uses FreeType to make font support available on Nano Server.
Generates native symbol packages for Apple platforms during packaging to improve native crash diagnostics.

contributor_summaries.jeffska: Improved Nano Server font support with FreeType
contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Added Graphite GPU backend bindings for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn

preview_summaries.v4.152.0-rc.1.26426.14: Release Candidate 1 completed the m152 engine update with native symbol packaging, Vulkan package production, and managed lifetime fixes.
preview_summaries.v4.152.0-preview.1.1: Preview 1 introduced the m152 engine update, Graphite bindings, asynchronous readback APIs, and platform support improvements.

harfbuzz_summary: Improves HarfBuzz packaging and shaping efficiency, and fixes the lifetime of stream-backed blobs.
